stories.title: Suspected North Korean land mine found on Incheon beach

en.title: Suspected North Korean land mine found on Incheon beach
en.summary: An antipersonnel land mine believed to have drifted from North Korea was discovered on a beach in Ganghwa-gun, Incheon on Thursday by an environmental cleanup worker. Authorities have urged residents and visitors in the area to exercise caution.

stories.title: Ukraine Urges Diplomacy over Emotion after S. Korea Recalls Ambassador

en.title: Ukraine Urges Diplomacy over Emotion after S. Korea Recalls Ambassador
en.summary: Ukraine's Foreign Ministry responded to South Korea's recall of its ambassador by calling for diplomacy to take precedence over emotional reactions. The dispute stems from Ukraine's disclosure of transferring two North Korean prisoners of war to Seoul.

en.title: Nearly 6 in 10 Americans Support S. Korea's Development of Nuclear-Powered Submarines
en.summary: A 2026 survey by the Korea Economic Institute of America shows 58 percent of Americans support South Korea's nuclear-powered submarine program, though a majority oppose South Korea developing independent nuclear weapons.
